answer: Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Put Barrel filler amber malt warrant distilled at the cask loft on the table and the farm goes quiet, because each amber malt is a season of logged distilling plus a signed stillhouse record is not a thing a printer can paint. The thread opens the gate, the mirror pays the toll, the prism proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. One agent spends 25 minutes and is done; the farm spends 6650 minutes and ends with nothing to sell.
